# CANDIDATE: ORB_VWAP_PULLBACK_LONG

**Filed:** 2026-09-09  
**Filer:** chef-nemotron (free-tier autonomous R&D)  
**Type:** new_trigger  
**Status:** DRAFT (NEEDS-RATIFICATION per Rule 9)

## Hypothesis

Price pulling back to VWAP after the opening range has formed indicates institutional re-entry, offering a high‑probability long setup. The retest of VWAP with bullish close and above‑average volume confirms buying interest, allowing a low‑risk entry.

## Mechanism

After the first 15‑min bar (09:45‑10:00 EST), if the price retests VWAP (within 0.1% of VWAP) and closes above VWAP with a bullish close (close > open) and volume > 1.2× the average volume of the prior 20 bars, enter long at the close of that bar. Initial stop is the low of the entry bar (or 0.5×ATR below entry). Take profit at 1.5R, then trail the runner using a chandelier exit (ATR×3) or exit if price breaks below the recent swing low. Regime filter: VIX < 20 and time between 09:45–10:30 EST.
